description: Upon entering Hakugyokurou, you encounter Yuyuko, who has absorbed a large amount of Spring Energy. The maiden welcomes everyone to view the flowers, but as the conversation progresses, it gradually turns confrontational, creating a微妙 atmosphere.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "You could also go see for yourself in Gensokyo."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl tilts her head, pretending not to have heard the question about Spring Energy.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "It's not like everyone is together in the Netherworld."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "It's nice in the Netherworld, isn't it~"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "But because of your borrowing, more lives have been lost."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Protest, protest! Without this spring, I might not be able to see future springs."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Please don't let this Saigyou Ayakashi bloom."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl puffs her cheeks, looking somewhat troubled.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Ge Qing has some experience; reasoning doesn't work with incidents, it has to be settled by force.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Eh? Miss Ge Qing" #lowering voice "That's a bit too rough, isn't it?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl covers her face with her fan, laughing.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #A surge of momentum, entering a furious state again.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: She flicks her fan lightly, and several Spring Energy cherry blossom petals gather around her.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "If the Spring Energy shield is broken by you all..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "How scary... and you have the nerve to call us willful?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yes, yes! We absolutely won't lose! To bring back spring!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Well then, shall we give it a try?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The girl lightly laughs and waves her fan; specks of light composed of Spring Energy petals begin to erode the surrounding space until the entire area is dyed pink. "Yes, a feast." "Until you dance to your death..." .rd20

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "That's too tragic, having to dance even after death."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Lina Yuyuko Xueyu Ge Qing Long'er

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It's better for the dead to rest more."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Spring Domain: A scene, a paradise composed of Spring Energy. Yuyuko replenishes 1d4 points of Spring Energy Shield here at the end of each round. "No need for long sleep in life~ nor long rest in death~" The girl replies with an off-key little tune. [CQ:mface,summary=[Yukari spreads hands],url=https://gxh.vip.qq.com/club/item/parcel/item/1d/1d3c553c1716bcc334c73222a68c6f12/raw300.gif,emoji_id=1d3c553c1716bcc334c73222a68c6f12,emoji_package_id=236877,key=c3d7d39a3b744954]

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Then, there's essentially no difference between life and death." [CQ:at,qq=3098965959] #Long'er replies with a meaningful statement

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "You can come keep me company when you die, the difference is huge, huge~"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The Spring Energy here isn't just for you to use, I can too!" #Extends both hands to gather the drifting Spring Energy in front; a pink glow envelops Lina's entire body. "Bet you didn't expect this place to become my aid!" #Uses the vitality of the Spring Energy to make the earth grow giant trees, trapping the girl within them.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I might be painfully digested..." #Looks back at the Devourer wriggling in his own shadow.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Blooming Fairy Lina]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+3d4+1d6=17+{4+2+1}(7)+{3}(3)=27 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 4

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Blooming Fairy Lina]'s 'Existence Record'... Updated: [MP]: 12-1=11 [Blooming Fairy Lina]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+5d4=3+{1+1+1+2+2}(7)=10 Challenge: 10 Failure

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What happened?!" #Frantically throws away the tree root in hand. "You did this, didn't you! You almost got me killed!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Ability to Manipulate the Degree of Death: Yuyuko's counterattack is replaced by forcing the opponent to make a Soul check. If their Soul check result is less than half of Yuyuko's Shield value, the attack was merely an illusion, and the real body is being led towards death.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "When people are near death, they might experience hallucinations. That's probably what that ability is."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Such... such a powerful opponent. Feels completely different from everyone we've met before..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "This is a method of making friends."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The moment Yuyuko unfolds her folding fan, time seems to stretch. An unknown melody resounds throughout the space.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In the distance, the girl who had done all this reveals an expectant look, seemingly waiting for Long'er to die and become her companion.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Great Writer]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+3d4+3d4+2d4+2d4+2d6=5+{2+4+4}(10)+{4+2+2}(8)+{1+3}(4)+{3+4}(7)+{2+4}(6)=40 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 6

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er's figure is instantly engulfed and disappears within the phosphorescent powder and the pink cloud of Reverse Butterflies. But a pitch-black door is slowly opening within the cloud. Accompanied by the firing of the Messiah Fist's grappling hook, Long'er, now half-skeletonized with an Aztec gold coin in his mouth, is using all his strength to claw his way out of the door.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Mugen Tenjouin Long'er]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+6d4+2d6=5+{2+3+3+2+1+4}(15)+{6+1}(7)=27 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 4

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Long'er, having crawled out of the door, returns to the battlefield shrouded in the aura of death, but his left shoulder is still affected, missing a large chunk.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Go! Devourer... Huh? Ahhhhh!" #The girl commands the creature to attack Yuyuko, but perhaps the Devourer's instinct to consume finally overwhelms it when faced with this漫天 of food. It breaks free from the girl's control and starts devouring the漫天 Spring Energy. Then, it turns its drooling gaze towards Yuyuko and the nearby Saigyou Ayakashi. Once again, it inflates itself to a size that blots out the sky and charges towards the incredibly delicious "food." "I'm sorry!" #Xueyu seems to be apologizing to the devoured Spring Energy, but this doesn't hinder her in the slightest as she drags the unwieldy Saw Cleaver and dashes at high speed towards Yuyuki. Under the Devourer's sky-blotting shadow, Xueyu arrives silently at Yuyuko's side. The heavy Saw Cleaver she drags scrapes against the ground, producing brilliant crimson sparks. Then, that ominous red light streaks down like a meteor from beside Yuyuko.

conversation.speaker: player6
conversation.text: [Elusive Devouring Luo Xueyu]'s 'Soul Hunt' Check: Roll: 1D20+Soul(6)d4=7+{2+2+3+2+4+1}(14)=21 Challenge: 10 Success Success Level: 3
